name: BossDB Nuclei Segmentation
summary: Segments cell nuclei in a public BossDB image cutout with a pretrained MONAI 3D U-Net run through PyTorch Connectomics, writing a binary Neuroglancer precomputed segmentation.
description: Reads a voxel cutout from a public BossDB precomputed channel, min-max normalizes it, runs the baked-in 3D U-Net with eight-way flip test-time augmentation, and thresholds the sigmoid probabilities into a binary nucleus mask (0 background, 1 nucleus). Use it for semantic nucleus detection in EM volumes; it does not assign separate IDs to individual nuclei. The model was trained at 64 x 64 x 40 nm, so select the BossDB mip with that voxel size; intended for one NVIDIA GPU (CPU fallback is slow).

inputs.description: BossDB image channel reference of the form bossdb://collection/experiment/channel.
inputs.requirements: Public channel stored as precomputed CloudVolume data; best results at 64 x 64 x 40 nm voxel size.

outputs.description: Neuroglancer precomputed uint32 segmentation (0 background, 1 nucleus) aligned to the requested start coordinate, plus inference.json with run metadata.

parameters.description: Inclusive start x coordinate, in voxels of the selected mip.
Inclusive start y coordinate, in voxels of the selected mip.
Inclusive start z coordinate, in voxels of the selected mip.
Exclusive stop x coordinate, in voxels of the selected mip.
Exclusive stop y coordinate, in voxels of the selected mip.
Exclusive stop z coordinate, in voxels of the selected mip.
Zero-based source mip level; if the bounds do not fit it, the app may switch to the single compatible mip at the model's training resolution.
Inclusive probability threshold (0-1) above which a voxel is labelled nucleus.

failure_modes.message: BossDB channel was not found or is not public
failure_modes.fix: Use a public BossDB channel URI.

failure_modes.message: threshold must be a number from 0 through 1
